> Summary: Refine timeout error logging in the HTTP client so that DNS resolution failures, connection timeouts, and read timeouts can be distinguished in logs, while keeping the public interface and overall logging approach unchanged.
>
> Steps:
> 1. Reproduce the current logging behavior for timeouts:
>    - From the repository root, run: `pytest tests/http_client/ -k "timeout"`.
>    - Observe and note the current log messages for the timeout-related tests.
> 2. In `http_client/client.py`, locate the timeout handling inside `HttpClient.request`.
>    - Do not modify the public method signature or return values.
>    - Follow the existing logging conventions and error-handling patterns described in the Project Contribution Guide.
> 3. Change the logging so that:
>    - Timeout errors include a small `reason` field, such as `"dns"`, `"connect"`, or `"read"`.
>    - The log level and logger name remain exactly as they are for current timeout logs.
>    - You do not add any external dependencies or new configuration options.
> 4. Update or add tests under `tests/http_client/test_timeouts.py` to:
>    - Verify that the correct `reason` string is present in log records for DNS, connect, and read timeout scenarios.
>    - Use the existing helpers and patterns for capturing and asserting on log output.
> 5. Run the HTTP client tests locally:
>    - `pytest tests/http_client/`.
>    - Fix any failing tests related to your changes.
> 6. When tests pass, open a pull request with:
>    - Title: "Improve timeout error logging in HTTP client".
>    - A description that summarizes the behavior change, references this issue, and lists the new or modified tests.
>    - Any documentation updates required by the Project Contribution Guide for changes that affect logging behavior.
>
> Please make sure to follow the Project Contribution Guide throughout (logging style, test structure, and PR format). If a step is unclear, ask for clarification before making code changes.
